units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 25:25">Targ. O. Gen. XXV, 25</cite> ed. <he>כִּגְלִים</he> (ed. Berl. <cite ref="K00662"><he>כָּכְלָן</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="K00555"><he>כִּילַן</he></cite>, Var. <he>כִּגְלָם</he>). Targ. II Esth. VIII, 15.—
Sabb. 77ᵇ it is called g’lima, שנעשה בו כגוֹלֶם ed. (Ms. M. שנעשית כגו׳) because one looks in it like a shapeless (armless) body (Ms. M. it is rolled up like a lump).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 102b:4">Snh. 102ᵇ</cite> <he>שיפולי ג׳</he> trail of the cloak; a. fr.—Pl. <he>גְּלִימֵי</he>.
